summary: Kalimba: soft plucked tines, afrobeat, chill, lofi, ambient
label: kalimba
body: Repeating patterns of a few notes.

Register: MIDI 55-91 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Kalimba, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Kalimba") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
